description: This file implements a program synthesis engine for converting between different API representations in the PyTorch code generation system. It defines types, a translation function, and rules for synthesizing expressions based on target types and available bindings.

classes.name: UnsatError
classes.description: Custom exception class used to indicate unsatisfiable translation goals.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Synthesizes a list of expressions to convert given bindings into target types, using rules and inference to generate code expressions.
